user_questions.question: When an open High-priority case has not been modified for 4 hours, what should escalation do? A) Mark it escalated only (IsEscalated = true) and email the case owner with the existing SupportEscalatedCaseNotification template [recommended; standard escalation rule]; B) Mark it escalated and reassign it to a new Escalations queue (no Case queue exists today) - if so, who should be the queue members?; C) Mark it escalated and also set Status = 'Escalated' (value exists). Also: should the 4 hours count business hours only? (only BusinessHours is Default 24x7)
user_questions.simulated_answer: B: set IsEscalated and reassign to an Escalations queue; only open (not Closed) cases, 4 hours with no modification. Business hours not required. Queue members: No preference; use your recommended default.
